messages:
Elaine (Marketing): Hey team — Pinebridge signed off on the benchmark results and is open to a short customer spotlight. Want to 1) lock a quick quote, 2) schedule a 30min recording, 3) ensure legal okay to publish perf graphs, and 4) route any inbound leads from the benchmark page. Timeline: target launch + webinar in 3 weeks.
Sam (Content): Nice — I can draft interview Qs and a short pull-quote. Can someone share the PR contact at Pinebridge and confirm who owns the graphs (customer or our team)?
Toni (AE): I own the account. PR contact is Julia Park (julia@pinebridge.ai). I'll intro you to her today. For leads: prefer Marketo form + immediate handoff to the AE queue.
Raj (Legal): Quick flags: need written permission for any named performance claims and graphs. We have a standard "Customer Data & Quote Release" template — Toni, can you get that signed? Also check if any redacted numbers are required for compliance.
Devon (CS): We ran the perf suite on their prod-like env. I can export the charts and attach CSVs. Note: two outlier runs where throttling hit — I'll annotate. If you publish the raw graph we should add a note about test conditions.
Sam (Content): Draft quote suggestion: "Redwood's platform cut inference tail latency in half for our 20k qps steady-state, letting us ship feature X faster." Thoughts? Too product-y?
Elaine (Marketing): Love the angle. Sam — make a 2-line and a 1-sentence version for web and tweet. Raj — can you pre-approve the quote language so Toni can get Julia's sign-off quickly?
Raj (Legal): I can pre-approve if we avoid specific SLA numbers until Pinebridge signs. Replace "20k qps" with "our production workload" and we can sign off. If they want the exact number public, we'll need explicit written opt-in.
Toni (AE): I'll ask Julia if they'd like the exact figures public. If not, 'production workload' + a percent improvement is fine. I'll push the release form today.
ops-bot: Recording room reserved: "Marketing-Case-Spotlight-3" on 1743350400 (3/30 10:00 PT). Link: https://meet.redwood/rooms/marketing-case-spotlight-3
Devon (CS): Sam — attaching the annotated chart export in the next message (will include a short caption about the env). Also recommend a 2-slide appendix for the webinar with the test methodology.
Sam (Content): For interview Qs (short list): 1) What was the main objective? 2) What baseline were you comparing against? 3) What did adopting Redwood change day-to-day? 4) Any surprises? 5) Approve the quote below? I'll send a recording guide + consent language.
Elaine (Marketing): Can we also plan a 20–30 min webinar format: 10min case highlight + 10min demo + 10min Q&A. Toni — please confirm customer speaker availability. Dev — can you spare an engineer for the demo?
Toni (AE): Will confirm speaker availability by EOD tomorrow. Julia said they prefer a product-marketing co-presenter rather than an engineer, but can bring a technical backup.
Devon (CS): I can be backup for Q&A and demo if needed.
Raj (Legal): Once Toni gets the signed release, please drop the signed PDF in #legal-approvals and ping me. I'll fast-track the review.
Sam (Content): I'll draft the blog + social copy and share in a PR for edits tomorrow. Quick ask: any embargo? Elaine?
Elaine (Marketing): Yes — embargo until the webinar date. Do NOT publish charts/quote until we have the signed release.
Toni (AE): Got it. Routing for inbound leads: I'll request a hidden form on the benchmark page that tags 'pinebridge-benchmark' and auto-notifies AE queue + CS Slack channel.
Sam (Content): Perfect. I'll add a small CTA in the blog "Request a benchmark readout" that posts to that form.
Elaine (Marketing): Great — plan of record: Toni to get release signed, Dev to finalize charts + appendix, Sam drafts assets, Raj pre-approves quote language (no hard numbers), ops-bot confirmed recording room. Check-ins daily this week. :thumbsup:
Toni (AE): On it. Will update thread when release is signed.
Raj (Legal): I'll review as soon as signed PDF is posted.
Devon (CS): Chart export done — sending to Sam and Elaine now.
Sam (Content): Received — thanks. I'll share the first draft by tomorrow noon.
Elaine (Marketing): Thanks everyone — moving to the next step. If anything blocks, ping me here. :rocket:
